aboutGame.title: What is TBOD Tycoon But One Dropper?
paragraphs: TBOD Tycoon But One Dropper is an innovative Roblox factory simulation game that flips classic tycoon mechanics on their head. Instead of spamming dozens of identical droppers across your plot, you rely on a single primary dropper, challenging you to maximize every ore through clever conveyor routing, upgrader sequencing, and multiplier loops.

As your factory grows, you unlock advanced processing equipment, trade with merchants, earn Bits and Essence, and trigger rebirths to scale your income exponentially. Whether you are aiming for leaderboard dominance or discovering hidden badges, our wiki provides comprehensive guides to optimize your factory.
